title: The Robot's Memory Book
goal: A file called CLAUDE.md is a memory the robot reads first.
mascot_lines: Memory is just a little list of rules our helper carries around.
We pick what goes on the list — short, clear notes work best.
Memory makes the helper feel like it knows you, even when you start a fresh chat.
It's not magic. It's just a list. But a good list goes a long way.

tier2.rephrase: Stack three rules into a pretend memory book.

tier3.nudge: Each block is one rule the robot will remember forever.
